findings.issue: 接受佣兵任务只是前置，实际需在指定地点完成异刃任务；不能标为完成指定佣兵任务可开环。
findings.resolution: 佣兵任务接受前置不作为开环手段；同时包含指定地点和异刃任务的要求已改为手动。

method: Independent live HTTP reads and independent table extraction. All 2408 rows, source links, branch order and gate/skill partition compared to freshly read Wiki. Rule exclusions scanned independently. Engine checked against all actual direct-frontier rows and tier boundaries.
limitations: eligible 表示依据 Wiki 排除清单进行推断，Wiki 并未逐个正面承诺每一项均可推进；网页已明确该判断口径。
